matches.description: Watch Guimaraes vs Casa Pia highlights and goals from Primeira Liga on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 12, 2026. The Primeira Liga action returned to the spotlight on May 12, 2026, as Vitoria de Guimaraes hosted Casa Pia AC in a match defined by tactical patience and defensive discipline. Both sides entered the pitch with clear objectives, setting the stage for a compelling battle of wills. Dominance Without Reward The opening half was characterized by heavy possession for the home side, as Vitoria de Guimaraes looked to exploit the wings through Noah Saviolo . Despite controlling the vast majority of the ball, clear-cut chances were hard to come by against a disciplined Casa Pia AC backline. Dailon Rocha Livramento offered a brief threat for the visitors in the 12th minute, but his effort from range failed to trouble the goalkeeper. As the match progressed, tensions rose, leading to a yellow card for Pedro Silva Rosas after a tactical foul to halt a counter-attack. Breaking the Deadlock The second period followed a similar pattern, with Vitoria de Guimaraes eventually reaching a staggering 71% of ball possession. Tactical changes from both benches attempted to swing the momentum, with players like Telmo Arcanjo and Oumar Camara adding fresh energy to the attack. The breakthrough finally arrived in the 86th minute. A precise pass from Joao Marques found Gaizka Larrazabal , who made no mistake with a clinical right-footed finish to send the home crowd into a frenzy. Late Drama and Final Whistle The final minutes were fraught with tension and physical tolls. Gaizka Larrazabal , the hero of the evening, unfortunately had to leave the field due to an injury in stoppage time, replaced by the veteran Jose Fonte . Despite late attempts by Casa Pia AC to find an equalizer and a headed chance for Alioune Ndoye at the other end, the scoreline remained unchanged. The final whistle confirmed a hard-fought victory for the hosts in a game where persistence eventually outlasted resistance.

Vitoria de Guimaraes controlled the lion's share of possession, but struggled to break down a compact Nacional defense. A pivotal moment arrived in the 28th minute when a VAR review for a potential penalty to the visitors was conducted, but the officials ultimately decided against the award, keeping the scoreline level at the break. Ramirez Strikes Amidst Penalty Drama The second half saw the game burst into life, with Nacional finding the breakthrough in the 69th minute. However, Nacional goalkeeper Kaique Pereira produced a stunning save to deny Samu from the spot, preserving the lead. As the clock ticked down, the drama intensified. In the 84th minute, Zeega committed a foul on Pablo Ruan inside the box, handing Nacional a chance to double their advantage. Following a VAR confirmation, Jesus Ramirez stepped up in the 86th minute and coolly converted the penalty, sending Charles the wrong way. Despite the visitors' late pressure and superior possession stats, Nacional held firm to secure a significant victory built on clinical efficiency.

matches.description: Watch Sporting CP vs Guimaraes highlights and goals from Primeira Liga on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 4, 2026. Two of the Primeira Liga 's most historic sides met on May 4, 2026, for a match that promised tactical intrigue and high intensity. The atmosphere was electric as the teams took to the pitch, both eager to secure crucial points in the league standings. Explosive Start at Alvalade The match ignited early as Sporting CP asserted their dominance from the opening whistle. In the 9th minute, a well-crafted move involving Pedro Goncalves and Luis Suarez found Goncalo Inacio , who rose highest to head the ball home. The home side refused to relent, and by the 24th minute, Daniel Braganca produced a moment of magic, Lofting a delicate lob over the goalkeeper following a precise pass from Hidemasa Morita to double the lead. VAR Drama and First-Half Dominance As the first half drew to a close, the pressure from Sporting CP remained relentless. Vitoria de Guimaraes struggled to maintain discipline, with Diogo Sousa and Noah Saviolo both receiving yellow cards. In stoppage time, Maximiliano Araujo found the net, but the celebrations were momentarily halted for a VAR review. After a brief wait, the goal was officially awarded in the 45+3 minute, giving the hosts a commanding three-goal cushion heading into the break. Clinical Finishing and Final Whistle The second half saw no dip in quality from the hosts. Luis Suarez turned scorer in the 61st minute, finishing clinically with his right foot after being set up by Pedro Goncalves . The rout continued in the 74th minute when substitute Luis Guilherme latched onto another Suarez assist to strike with his left. Despite a late blemish involving a Zeno Debast own goal in the 85th minute, Sporting CP remained in total control. Rui Silva made late saves to deny any further comeback attempts, securing a convincing 5-1 victory on a memorable night.
